meta.verdict_discipline: FAIL only for a CANON rule (tone guide, banned list, spelling, MDR-002). FLAG for anything resting on MDR-021 (Proposed), on the founder's 2026-09-03 vocabulary rule, or on judgement. PASS rows are included so the whole picture is visible, not only the problems.
meta.builds_on: docs/superpowers/plans/precision/farmer-facing-vocabulary-audit.md (453 strings / 259 terms / N1-N15). That audit has no screen dimension and no doctrine verdict; this one adds both and does not repeat its term list.
meta.read_only: No production code, copy, key or identifier was changed. Nothing here proposes a replacement word.

definitions.strings_inspected: one row per farmer-visible string per SCREEN it appears on; a string reused on three screens is three rows, which is the point of this audit
definitions.unique_strings: distinct text_mr values across those rows
definitions.unique_terms: distinct Devanagari or Latin word tokens across all inspected strings, with {placeholders} and bare numerals removed. NOT comparable to the flat audit's 259, which counted distinct entries in a hand-built vocabulary column
definitions.register: spoken = the -चं / -लं / -तंय colloquial form; written = the -चे / -ले / -ली literary form; n/a = the string carries no inflection to judge
